Horrible experience. I would never go back there
Feb 2022 • Couples
This place is overrated with offensively rude staff. My wife and I visited Pubbelly for dinner while vacationing. We had reservations, but upon arrival our table wasn’t ready yet - no big deal, we weren’t in a rush and went to the bar for a drink at the host’s suggestion. Before we were even planted on the barstool, we were approached by a waitress asking for our drink order. Apparently asking for a minute to look over the menu was the wrong move because we were ignored in the time that followed. Finally the manager came over and took our drink order. Before we were served the drinks, our table was ready so we got settled for the outdoor dining. Our waiter came over shortly thereafter and was so unwelcoming and crass. We had some questions, but feeling rushed and suspecting the waiter didn’t want to be bothered, we just placed an order for whatever caught our eye (2 rolls, an appetizer, and a dinner). Last second I ask the waiter what he recommends off the menu, and added that item as well. The food was served quickly and was visually appealing, but it was nothing to write home about. The sushi rolls were fine, but unremarkable, same sushi I get in NJ. The spare rib dinner was inedible - sauce was good but the ribs were so fatty I couldn’t get a bite. Unimpressed, we decide against dessert and my wife asks for the check. I’m not sure if they didn’t want us there, but our request for the bill finally prompted a quick response from service. Our bill was roughly $140, shown to me on a mobile check by the waiter. I asked to glance at it again, because he took it away without giving me the opportunity to review it. He obliges and stands there as I take out cash from my wallet. I give him $140, waiting a moment for him to go retrieve the dollar and change I was owed back. This guy literally stood there waiting for his tip, eavesdropping as I consulted with my wife about it. He overhears my wife say to give him $30, after she confirms with him that gratuity was not included. Even though the food and service wasn’t great, we always try to tip decent since we acknowledge this is the waiters livelihood. So, sensing this waiter won’t leave our table without his money in hand, I take out more cash and hand him $40, since I had no smaller bills. He proceeds to rudely say “change?” and so frustrated, I literally got up and walked away. this guy never said thank you, so intrusively hovered over my wife and I during a private conversation and then acted greedily and rude. Avoid this place at all cost, not worth the hype
